author: Aaronjacobs000
summary: This parser reads Azure Key Vault AuditEvent records, streamed by a diagnostic setting to an event hub and read with an Azure Event Hubs integration. Every request goes to CloudAudit. The parser is a child of the global parser Azure_Monitor_Master.
notes:
Setup:
- Add a diagnostic setting on each key vault that streams the AuditEvent category to an event hub, and read the hub with a Sophos NG-SIEM Azure Event Hubs integration (Standard tier or above).
- Each record of an event hub batch reaches the parsers on its own: Azure_Monitor_Master claims single records and not the {"records": [...]} wrapper.

Saving in the console:
- The parser is a child of the global parser Azure_Monitor_Master, which claims each Azure resource log record but leaves Key Vault's in the generic schema.
- A standalone parser lost every line to Azure_Monitor_Master in a lab tenant.
- To add it in Sophos Fusion, choose Add Custom Parser, tick Set Global Parent in Parser Script and keep Parent parser (default): the parent picker lists only your own parsers, never built-in ones.
- Paste the whole file, !PARENT line included; its !SCHEMA line sets the schema, whatever the dialog shows.
- Without that option the save fails with "code contains restricted syntax: !PARENT"; turn the option on in the editor and save again.
- Saved this way in a lab tenant on 2026-10-15, it gave the same Run Test result while still disabled.

Field mapping:
- Every request (secrets, keys, certificates and the vault itself) goes to CloudAudit, with the operation (such as SecretGet) as the event name, the caller's UPN or app ID as the user, the subscription as the recipient account, and the secret, key or certificate as the object key and a resource.
- Vault operations are management events; gets, lists, backups and cryptographic operations are read-only.
- Records carry no event ID, and correlationId is optional and set by the client, so it goes to additional_event_data.
- The parser also reads the claims URI forms.

Made up in the samples:
- Samples follow Microsoft's AuditEvent example and the AZKVAuditLogs columns with made-up values.
- The samples write vault hosts under azure.example, because the library's sample scan won't take Microsoft's service domain, and use the short upn claim.

Testing:
- The parser passed Run Test in a lab tenant on 2026-10-14 as a child of Azure_Monitor_Master (123 of 123 fields matched the emulator in each of 3 runs, every line through Azure_Monitor_Master to this parser).

Known gaps:
- No live event hub was available.
